description.zh: 用于确保实际更改的资源和期望更改的资源是一致的，该值来自Create，Get和Update API的响应。
description.en: The header that is used to ensure that the changed resources are consistent with resources to be changed. The value comes from the response of the Create, Get, and Update API operations.

description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

description.zh: 调用函数的ID，与返回参数requestId对应。
description.en: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API. The value is the same as that of the requestId parameter in the response.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open delete-function --if-match e19d5cd5af0378da05f63f891c7467af --service-name demoService --function-name demoFunction --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id test-trace-id --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
